notes.title: REDDOOR Update Version 5.16
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42781929/820605077427685b0189186295bb2688b6181021.png

NEW MAP: CODENAME ARTEMIS

    Explore the expansive and atmospheric Codename Artemis map.
    Navigate through new and challenging moon base to survive the undead.

NEW FEATURES:

    Misc Settings:
        Auto Aim: Added an option to enable or disable auto aim for easier targeting.
        Glyph Style: Choose between PC or Xbox input glyphs for a customized control display.

STATS:

    Leaderboards:
        All game modes and maps now feature leaderboards.
        Compete with friends and players worldwide to top the charts.

PROGRESSION:

    Item Integration:
        Items are now integrated into your Steam inventory.
        Levels are reset to 1, providing a fresh start for all players.
        As you level up, receive a random skin with over 200+ skins available.

AUDIO UPDATES:

    New MainMenu Music:
        Enjoy a refreshed audio experience with new music for the MainMenu.

GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS:

    Map Geometry Fixes:
        Various fixes to map geometry to improve navigation and eliminate bugs.
    General Bug Fixes:
        Numerous bug fixes to enhance overall game stability and performance.

NEW GAME MODE: CHAOS

    Chaos Mode:
        Start at round 10 with 25,500 points.
        Zombies spawn at twice the usual rate, creating an intense and challenging experience.

VISUAL ENHANCEMENTS:

    New Gore and Blood Effects:
        Enhanced gore and blood effects for a more visceral and immersive experience.

GAME BALANCING:

    Weapon Balancing:
        Adjustments to weapon stats for a more balanced gameplay experience.

NEW ACHIEVEMENTS:

    Achievements:
        New achievements added to reward your progress and accomplishments in the game.

AND MORE . . .


Thank you for playing REDDOOR We hope you enjoy the new features and enhancements in update version 5.16! Your continued support and feedback are invaluable to us.

notes.title: v5.15 FULL RELEASE
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42781929/3cd2229718516494263f00b73d64757a79616c11.png
    New MainMenu Music:
        Immerse yourself in the game with a fresh MainMenu music track.
        Enhance the overall atmosphere of your gaming experience.

    New Round End and Start Sounds:
        Experience the end and beginning of rounds with new and exciting sounds.
        The new sounds are designed to be cohesive with the MainMenu music, creating a seamless transition.

    Zombie Count (Setting Toggle):
        Added a toggle in the settings menu to display the number of zombies remaining.
        Stay informed about the remaining challenges and adjust your strategy accordingly.

    Sprint Toggle (Setting Toggle):
        Introduced a sprint toggle setting for players who prefer a toggle sprint functionality.
        Choose the sprint method that suits your playstyle.

    Bug Fixes and Performance Enhancements:
        Resolved an issue where iron sights and switching to scope could cause unexpected behavior.
        Enjoy a smoother and more reliable aiming experience.

        Various bug fixes and performance improvements to ensure a more stable and enjoyable gaming experience.

    UI/UX Enhancements:
        Polished and improved the user interface and experience for better navigation and clarity.

    Optimized Sound System:
        Optimized the sound system to ensure a more immersive and high-quality audio experience.


Thank you for playing REDDOOR. We hope you enjoy the new features and improvements in REDDOOR version 5.15!

- JKFY TEAM
